standard: Acceptable visible refinement at application scale; not a numerical quality rating or production release approval. Protected art remains unchanged. Modest frame/edge improvements and residual simplifications are identified in each view note.

front.note: Orange semicircle and navy circle remain crisp inside the softly finished white sheet edge.

rear.note: The plain white backing is continuous; softened perimeter catches a restrained highlight.

detail.note: Original print texture and two corner pins remain readable without new surface noise.

underside.note: Thin lower edge stays connected around the full artwork with no visible opening.

clay.note: The shallow sheet and small fasteners read clearly; improvement is restrained edge finishing.

front.note: Request correction: sharp polygonal upper and lower bouts still dominate the dreadnought silhouette.

rear.note: The support stand is coherent, but the back body outline repeats the coarse angular waist.

detail.note: Strings, frets and rosette are good; smooth the body contour and its binding without moving these details.

underside.note: Tripod feet and cradle contact appear intact; body edges still need curved construction.

clay.note: The material-free view confirms angular body geometry, not a lighting or texture problem.

front.note: Fan back, broad arms and stepped seat read clearly with warmer directional timber grain.

rear.note: Rear slats meet their cross rails and legs without detached joints or missing surfaces.

detail.note: Fine grain follows the boards; softened ends improve the already recognizable chair construction.

underside.note: Seat boards, side rails and leg connections form a coherent underside.

clay.note: Separated slats and thick arm supports remain legible without relying on the wood map.

front.note: Raised head segment and low retaining rail clearly distinguish the adjustable bed.

rear.note: Rear support and raised mattress remain aligned above the rectangular base frame.

detail.note: Soft edges improve the pads; the dark side gap at the bend remains a deliberate segment joint.

underside.note: Lift support, cross frame and legs remain visible and connected beneath the raised deck.

clay.note: Segmented mattress remains simple rather than richly upholstered; acceptable as this specialized bed type.

front.note: Three differently aimed lamp cans stay connected to a continuous ceiling rail.

rear.note: The dark metal rail and stepped lamp backs have restrained surface response.

detail.note: Pivot necks and concentric rear rings remain separate and readable at close range.

underside.note: All three warm lens discs are seated inside their cylindrical housings.

clay.note: The rail, pivots and can silhouettes remain clear without materials; no missing attachment apparent.

clay.note: The two-pad geometry and squared steel supports are coherent; no silhouette regression visible.

rear.note: Rear pouch, scarf and separated legs remain readable with softened small edges.

detail.note: Fine coat grain adds material distinction while the stylized face and hands stay clean.

underside.note: The plinth is closed below and both feet remain visibly seated on it.

clay.note: Block-built toy anatomy is intentional; layered scarf, arms and boots remain clear.

rear.note: Smooth back shell meets the rim without exposed interior gaps or detached panels.
